validation_gate: Full CI build and CPU test suite across all seven engine legs plus live 4x GB10 (TP=4, 200G switch, uncapped clocks) GLM-5.3 bench/bench.py verification for standard bit325 quality default (MOE_UNION_CAP=48), fast preset (MOE_UNION_CAP=32), and K4 bit387 uncapped pure quality (MOE_UNION_CAP=0), plus C=4 GSM8K-250, HumanEval-164, and sustained 4x153.6K long-context concurrency.

default_or_cache_changes.change: All 8 bit-exact #542 decode, prefill, and DFlash2 kernels enabled by default (KL=0.00000); DEC_BK_MAX=2048 (#549) and REUSE_GRID=64 (#524, #527) defaulted at TP=4 int4; MOE_UNION_CAP=48 defaulted at TP=4 (#551).
default_or_cache_changes.rollback: Set MOE_UNION_CAP=0 (--moe-union-cap 0) for strict uncapped exact routing (KL=0.00000); set MOE_UNION_CAP=32 for fast mode; set DEC_BK_MAX=32768 to restore prior decode buckets.

default_or_cache_changes.change: Default width variant moved to bit325 (v0.6 release profile, #539).
default_or_cache_changes.rollback: Pass VARIANT=home (--variant home) when booting older v0.5 checkpoints.

default_or_cache_changes.change: V2 BF16 tensor-core projections enabled by default (#510); forced tools default to native non-thinking mode with parked chats (#519).
default_or_cache_changes.rollback: Set EXACT=1 for exact math; pass --forced-tool-thinking 1 and --extra-env GR8_DS_PARK=0 to restore earlier behavior.

default_or_cache_changes.change: Persistent session index resets once on binary upgrade while preserving the preallocated SSD block file.
default_or_cache_changes.rollback: None required; active sessions prefill once on first boot.

toolchain_changes: Dockerfile adds bin/kvman-peer (#538) and bin/g6m4_ink2 / bin/m4sim_ink2 (#512) to dist; CUDA (13.0.1), base OS (ubuntu24.04), Rust (1.94.1), and runtime apt packages are unchanged.
operational_notes: Use v0.6 bit325 checkpoint (3e388b45) with default glm53 TP=4 launches, or pass VARIANT=home for older v0.5 checkpoints.
Quality-first recipes (such as K4 bit387) should explicitly set MOE_UNION_CAP=0 to opt out of TP=4's default MOE_UNION_CAP=48.
New ./gr8 <model> scale --tp N --peers LIST supports orderly hold/drain/rollback cluster width scaling with SSD KV carry.
